annotations.title: Check whether an AI engine recommends a brand

description: Use this when someone asks whether an AI answer engine names or cites a brand for a buying question, or which other brands it names. Sends one question to one search-grounded engine through its API and returns whether the brand was named, whether its domain was cited, which of the listed competitors were named, and the pages the answer cited. Each call is a fresh API request with no account history or personalization, and one question is one datapoint, not an overall visibility score.

brand.description: The brand or product name to look for in the answer.

competitors.description: Up to 3 competitor names to check for in the same answer.

domain.description: The brand's domain. Supplying it enables citation detection, not just name matching.

engine.description: Which engine answers: perplexity (the default) or chatgpt.

question.description: A question a buyer would actually type, e.g. "best tool for tracking AI search visibility". Not a keyword: the engines answer questions.

name: check_ai_visibility
title: Check whether an AI engine recommends a brand
